evidence.quote: Licensed firms should observe the JFIU’s transitional arrangements as set out below:
the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

lost_or_added_conditions: The executable bundle adds valid_from = 2026-09-26, after the entire blackout. Preservation requires an explicit distinction between bundle-version validity and the historical instant being assessed; none is supplied.

Urgency is tested at the assessed instant, while contact may occur anywhere during the blackout. The executable does not establish that credited contact occurred by that instant or addressed the urgency being assessed.
The test covers one firm and one STR. Its Boolean result cannot establish performance for all qualifying STRs.
Urgency classification and completion of urgent reporting remain unresolved; r2_completion is explicitly unencoded.
value.rationale: The decomposition faithfully retains the licensed-firm actor, SHOULD modality, listed contact alternatives, blackout endpoints and distinction between contact and completed submission. Leaving completion unencoded is an honest residual. However, executable correspondence is not established because temporal applicability and the relationship between historical contact and instantaneous urgency remain unspecified. The proposed relation alone cannot resolve those gaps.

provenance.transport_retry_policy: NO_APPLICATION_RETRY; CLI transport behavior is external
